# Global brand partner programs

<!-- Generated by scripts/partner-programs.mjs from data/partner-programs-brands.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

The household names outside technology: carmakers, robotics and space, entertainment, music and sports, games publishers, toys, consumer and luxury brands, retail, telecoms, and the consultancies. They look out of reach the way IBM and OpenAI did, until someone opens the partner page. The doors here are mostly innovation programs, accelerators, corporate venture arms, open calls, and developer platforms rather than partner networks, and access is honestly scored: most are competitive, some are invite-only, and a few are open today.

It is the wide net. The narrower docs stay authoritative for what they cover: [partners.md](../partners.md) is what each live partnership **is** and how to describe it, [opportunities.md](./opportunities.md) is the stuck-item pipeline, [prospects.md](./prospects.md) scores the 3D and avatar ecosystem, and the [listings registry](../listings-registry.md) tracks directories and awesome-lists.

Sibling pages: [big-tech partner programs](./big-tech-programs.md), [ai company partner programs](./ai-programs.md), [motion partner programs](./motion-programs.md), [crypto ecosystem partner programs](./crypto-programs.md), plus [who promotes partners](./promotion-programs.md) and [moonshots](./moonshots.md) across every sector.

**92 programs across 91 companies.** 43 eligible, not started, 26 verify fit first, 23 retired or closed. We hold at least one membership at 0 of the 91 companies, and 16 of the open programs offer some form of promotion. Last full research sweep: 2026-11-06.

## Using this page

```sh
npm run programs:next -- --sector brands   # the ranked next actions, top 15
npm run programs:due -- --sector brands    # deadlines and expiring benefits in the next 30 days, submissions to chase
npm run programs:promo -- blog --sector brands   # programs that will promote us, by type
npm run programs -- --log <id> --action "Submitted the application" --status submitted --ref <url>
npm run programs -- --benefit <id> --name "Cloud credits" --value "USD 25,000" --state received --received 2026-11-06 --expires 2027-11-06
npm run programs:build                    # regenerate this page after editing data/partner-programs-brands.json by hand
```

`--log` and `--benefit` update [data/partner-programs-brands.json](../../data/partner-programs-brands.json) and rebuild this page in one step. Log every submission the day it happens, with the confirmation link or email subject as `--ref`; log every benefit the day it lands, with its expiry. That is the whole tracking discipline.

**Scores** use the same F·R·A scale as [prospects.md](./prospects.md#how-a-prospect-is-scored): **F**it (5 = already in our code), **R**each (5 = millions of the right users or buyers), **A**ccess (5 = self-serve form, 1 = no public route), summed to 3-15.

## The plan

Every active program sits in exactly one wave. Work the waves in order; inside a wave, work top to bottom (highest score first). A program moves waves only when its status changes, so updating status is how the plan stays current.

## Who promotes partners

The open programs on this page that will put three.ws in front of their audience: co-marketing, social posts, blog posts, case studies, newsletters, featured placement, events, podcasts, press, or a partner badge. Ranked by promotion value: the program score plus two points for each kind of promotion one ask earns. Ask for the promotion in the same message as the application; it is far easier to get on the way in than after. The cross-sector view is [promotion-programs.md](./promotion-programs.md).

### Valve

**How we partner with Valve:** Steamworks is a self-serve USD 100 per app route for a /play desktop build.

| Program | Type | What it gives | Promotion | Who qualifies | Status | Next action | F·R·A |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Steamworks and Steam Direct](https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/gettingstarted/appfee) | Marketplace | Distribution of a /play desktop build to the Steam audience. |  | Any developer or company. Cost: USD 100 per app, recouped after USD 1,000 revenue. | Eligible, not started | Evaluate a Steam release of /play with a 30 day lead time. Apply: Create a Steamworks partner account, verify tax details and pay the per-app fee.. Cadence: rolling. | 3·5·5 = **13** |

- **Steamworks and Steam Direct.** Steam takes 30 percent. The fee is documented by Valve. A real self-serve door with household reach.

## Keeping it true

- **Never set `member` without proof**: an acceptance email, a portal that shows the membership, or a live listing. Record the proof as a `--log` entry with `--ref`.
- **Never upgrade a designation.** Program names and tiers are quoted exactly as the partner writes them; the framing rules in [partners.md](../partners.md#what-the-page-does-not-claim) apply here too.
- **Log the day it happens.** A submission that is not logged did not happen as far as the next person is concerned, and they will submit it again.
- **Re-sweep quarterly.** Programs get renamed, folded, and retired every few months. When a page 404s or redirects, set `closed` with the reason and the date so nobody re-researches it.
- **A new membership** also needs a card on `/partners` and `/partners/benefits` and a row in [partners.md](../partners.md) (see [partner-benefits.md](../partner-benefits.md#editing-rules)).
